intents.title: Invalid straighten no longer throws a console error
intents.reason: Maid never calls disabled() on an operation that does not apply, and disabled() is a pure function, so there is no console error path. Straighten's plan is pure (straightenPlan returns undefined instead of throwing), and the key handler stops at 'if (!operation) return' without a flash. The missing 'unavailable' flash on an unavailable key is a UX difference, not part of this fix.

intents.title: Territory-aware address hints (Hong Kong and Macao formats)
